title: ASP.NET Core System Design
description: Design scalable backend services with ASP.NET Core: APIs, microservices, messaging, caching, resilience, and data patterns.
longDescription: Learn to design production-grade ASP.NET Core systems. Covers REST API design, microservice communication, message brokers, distributed caching, resilience with Polly, background jobs, database scaling, and API gateways with gRPC.
whatYouLearn: API Gateway with YARP and gRPC
